rules.identifiers: Tenant-owned keys use opaque UUIDs and never names, email addresses, phone numbers or original filenames. Platform releases, models and datasets may retain stable technical artifact paths required by runtimes.
rules.videos: New showreels and self-tapes stay in Cloudflare Stream. Any historical video bytes copied for retention are legacy archives and must not be used for new uploads.
rules.database: The database owns display names, MIME type, size, checksum, ownership and entity relationships. S3 owns bytes only.

prefixes.platform/releases/{product}/{version}/{a: Shared application releases and downloadable artifacts
prefixes.platform/models/legacy-b2/{modelFamily}/: Historical B2 model variants retained without colliding with the authoritative model source
prefixes.platform/services/{service}/{assetFamily: Service-owned artifacts without a tenant owner
prefixes.platform/archives/{archiveType}/{assetId: Legacy or platform-owned archive data without a tenant owner
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/projects/: Files billed to and owned by a core organization
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/shared/{a: Organization-owned files not tied to a project
prefixes.workspaces/{workspaceId}/storyboards/{st: Legacy workspace animation sources with opaque identifiers
prefixes.users/{userId}/files/{assetId}/original: Private user files not owned by another entity
prefixes.users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/file: User-owned project files where no organization owner is established
prefixes.users/{userHash}/sound-room/{audioReview: Verified private Sound Room original from browser or Pro Tools
prefixes.temporary/{uploadId}: Unfinalized uploads; expires automatically after one day
prefixes.quarantine/{uploadId}: Rejected or suspicious uploads; expires automatically after fourteen days
prefixes.exports/{exportId}: Temporary GDPR exports; expires automatically after seven days
prefixes.migration/{source}/{migrationItemId}: Migration staging; retained until explicitly finalized
prefixes._system/: Non-personal storage manifests and operational metadata
